mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has risen above 4.0% over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 0.5% MoM) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness boosts corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1500) signal strong consumer demand and economic activity, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 1500 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE has risen above 5.0% over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 105.0), strong supply growth supports corporate output and profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 105.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in CPI above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL has risen above 3.5% over the past 3 months.
